title: PowerPoint on Mac: Copilot Agent Mode creates executive summary slides
summary: The briefing passes: its Mac availability and release facts match the roadmap, and Microsoft documents the licence-assignment path, PowerShell call and administrator roles it gives. The product-level licensing and privacy statements are supported; searches did not establish an executive-summary-specific licence tier, default or separate setting.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses is the licence-assignment path.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page. ... Select the row of the user ... In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. ... Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a licence through Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()
